hero.title: Bible Gifts turns Scripture into heirloom art gifts you can hold.
hero.subtitle: Each piece is crafted with architectural metals, carved timber, and luminous inks so ministries, collectors, and families can carry the story of redemption into daily life.
hero.ctaNote: Our atelier releases every edition in timed capsules—request a catalog to preview them before they go public.

collections.title: Curated collections ready for exhibitions and gifting
collections.description: Select from museum-grade formats that travel easily between church lobbies, festivals, and collector homes.

metal.title: Illuminated Metal Scriptures
metal.description: Laser-etched copper and brass layered with translucent enamels for dramatic light play; perfect for gallery walls and large-format liturgies.

wood.title: Carved Wood Icons
wood.description: Hand-carved hardwood panels with relief textures inspired by Genesis through Revelation, paired with accompanying devotionals.

print.title: Textured Collector Albums
print.description: Archival prints bound in artisan linen portfolios, each page treated with raised inks and QR-linked AR moments for immersive storytelling.

customization.title: Co-create a gift expression for your ministry
customization.message: We partner with pastors, curators, and marketplace leaders to design limited runs, event gifts, and donor collections that echo your mission.
customization.note: Send us your event date or collector goals and we will curate samples, pricing, and delivery timelines.
